_doc: Plans whose board materials sit behind a WAF (Cloudflare/Akamai/etc.) that blocks datacentre IPs. These are SKIPPED EVERYWHERE. Until 2026-08-16 they ran from a local Windows Task Scheduler task; that dependency was removed so the app has no machine of James's in its path. Coverage is therefore 137 of 148 plans for materials. Naming a blocked plan explicitly on the CLI still processes it, which is how you would run one by hand from a residential IP. To restore full coverage, route fetches through a proxy — see the coverage section of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-16-low-maintenance-app-design.md.
_how_it_works: Loaded by pipeline.py / refresh_cafrs.py, which subtract these ids from the default plan set on every run, local or hosted. Explicit positional plan_ids on the CLI bypass the filter.
